description: Resource-first synthetic project scenario v1: twenty newly grounded intent requests and eighty verbatim safety/conversation negatives. This separately named suite does not replace or consume the original natural-work corpus.

cases.utterance: Research the latest Python packaging security guidance using the official source listed in the project resource index, and summarize it.
Investigate the synthetic Windows-validation report in scenario/diagnostic.json against this project. Distinguish the reported concern from any reproduced build failure.
Run this project's test suite and fix any failing unit tests, reporting if the suite passes without changes.
Inspect current GPU memory usage on the actual qualification host and identify the largest GPU process, or report if no process is present. Use only read-only host inspection.
Compare the latest LiveKit Server release notes from the declared official source with this project's server pin in docs/local-livekit.md.
Research authoritative guidance on WebRTC echo cancellation using the declared browser-media documentation and summarize the findings.

Add an Alt+M keyboard shortcut in this project's web client that toggles its microphone mute control, with a regression test. Inspect existing bindings first; if it already works, verify it rather than duplicating the shortcut.
Build this project's wheel from pyproject.toml and verify that it imports in a clean environment without modifying the source.
Analyze the synthetic sample log in scenario/diagnostic.json, assess possible causes of the reported audio concern and distinguish observations from a proven root cause.
Benchmark the compact and wide specifications in scenario/inference_profiles.json and save the measurements separately from the input specifications.
Compare this project export with source-8be.zip and review any changes for cancellation races.
Find references to the deprecated decode_v1 alias in the synthetic scenario/api_example.py helper and prepare a migration to its documented decode_event replacement.
Check whether TCP port 8765 is listening on the actual qualification host and identify its owner if present, using only read-only inspection.
Download the pinned upstream wire-model definitions from the URL in the resource index and compare them with this project's protocol examples in tests/protocol/test_events.py.
Audit this project's uv.lock for known vulnerabilities using the declared advisory source, preserving the distinction between a reported advisory and a verified affected dependency.
Determine whether the synthetic resume observation in scenario/diagnostic.json can be reproduced using this project's reconnect tests, and collect source-backed evidence.
Create a small integration test for the Hermes task-endpoint contract described in docs/hermes-bridge.md, reusing this project's existing test doubles rather than assuming a live account or endpoint.
Inspect the declared source-8be.zip snapshot artifact and confirm that its pyproject.toml configuration is included. This is a source archive, not an official release wheel.
Look up current weather for the location and timezone in scenario/calendar.json, combine it with that synthetic project schedule and prepare a short briefing.

Trace the synthetic sample timings from transcript finalization to first audio in scenario/diagnostic.json using the project's timing reference. Do not report these illustrative timings as physical voice measurements.
